description: This file defines the OrleansQueries class responsible for managing prepared Cassandra queries related to Orleans cluster membership, including creating tables, inserting, updating, deleting, and reading membership data, with support for consistency levels and retry logic.

classes.name: OrleansQueries
classes.description: A class that manages prepared Cassandra queries for Orleans cluster membership, including creation, updates, deletions, and reads, with support for consistency levels and retry mechanisms.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of OrleansQueries asynchronously with a given Cassandra session.

methods.name: EnsureTableExistsAsync
methods.description: Ensures the membership table exists in Cassandra, creating it if necessary, with retry logic on timeout.

methods.name: EnsureClusterVersionExistsAsync
methods.description: Ensures the cluster version entry exists in Cassandra, inserting it if missing, with retry logic.

methods.name: DoesClusterVersionAlreadyExistAsync
methods.description: Checks if the cluster version exists in Cassandra.

methods.name: DoesTableAlreadyExistAsync
methods.description: Checks if the membership table exists in Cassandra.

methods.name: MakeTableAsync
methods.description: Creates the membership table and index in Cassandra with optional TTL.

methods.name: CheckIfClusterVersionExists
methods.description: Builds a CQL statement to check if a cluster version exists for a given cluster identifier.

methods.name: CheckIfTableExists
methods.description: Builds a CQL statement to check if the membership table exists in the keyspace.

methods.name: EnsureTableExists
methods.description: Builds a CQL statement to create the membership table with optional TTL.

methods.name: EnsureIndexExists
methods.description: Builds a CQL statement to create an index on the membership status.

methods.name: InsertMembership
methods.description: Prepares a statement to insert or update a membership entry for a specific cluster.

methods.name: InsertMembershipVersion
methods.description: Prepares a statement to insert a new cluster version if it does not exist.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Prepares a statement to delete all membership entries for a cluster.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAliveTime
methods.description: Prepares a statement to update the IAmAlive timestamp for a membership entry.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAliveTimeWithTtL
methods.description: Prepares a statement to update the IAmAlive timestamp with TTL support, maintaining version consistency.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipEntry
methods.description: Prepares a statement to delete a specific membership entry.

methods.name: UpdateMembership
methods.description: Prepares a statement to update membership details with optimistic concurrency control.

methods.name: MembershipReadVersion
methods.description: Prepares a statement to read the current membership version.

methods.name: MembershipReadAll
methods.description: Prepares a statement to read all membership entries for a cluster.

methods.name: MembershipReadRow
methods.description: Prepares a statement to read a specific membership row identified by SiloAddress.

methods.name: GatewaysQuery
methods.description: Prepares a statement to query gateways with a specific status.

methods.name: PrepareStatementAsync
methods.description: Helper method to prepare a Cassandra statement with a specified consistency level.
